script.title: Why Equal Equity Splits Destroy Startups
script.hook: Splitting equity fifty-fifty with a part-time cofounder is pure madness.

scenes.narration: Splitting equity fifty-fifty with a part-time cofounder is pure madness.
Many early teams hand out equal shares just to avoid awkward conversations at launch.
When one person puts in eighty hours and the other does ten resentment builds fast.
If they call vesting a sign of distrust, let them walk away immediately.
Always tie equity to a four year vesting schedule with a one year cliff.
How did you split equity with your cofounder without starting a war?
